settings.about.description:
A compact, transparent time, weather & environmental health monitor that lives on your desktop.
Track up to 5 cities at a glance — including live UV Index, AQI, PM2.5, wildfire smoke, and urban smog (NO₂, O₃) for outdoor runners, families, and asthma/allergy care.
